# LayerProps

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Add additional props to a layer (e.g., operation: "mask" for mask layers, beforeId for maplibre layer ordering).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/layer-props",
  "type": "LayerPropsOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/layer-props').par.layer` (an input) and `op('/layer-props').out.layer` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.layer`, `out.layer`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `layer` | `LayerField` |  |
| `operation` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `beforeId` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `additionalProps` | `UnknownField` | `{}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `layer` | `LayerField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
